_comment: Playable races (a character sheet's 'ancestry'): the creature type spells check (Hold Person works on humanoids), and racial traits. A trait's 'condition_immunities' can't be imposed on that race (Fey Ancestry: magic can't put elves to sleep); 'save_advantage' gives advantage on saves against those conditions. Creatures in creatures.json give their own 'type', 'race' and 'condition_immunities'. See docs/SPELLS.md.

fey_ancestry.name: Fey Ancestry
fey_ancestry.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

dwarven_resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarven_resilience.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison.

brave.name: Brave
brave.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
